notes: Chemically labile - depurinates rapidly - which is why immunohistochemistry rather than LC-MS/MS is the established route. Formed at sites of carcinogenesis in cancer-prone inflammatory disease (liver fluke; human papillomavirus; Epstein-Barr virus) and strong tumour formation has been closely associated with poor prognosis. Adds nitration as a damage chemistry distinct from oxidation; chronic inflammation is estimated to account for roughly a quarter of cancer cases

platform: aldehyde-reactive probe (ARP) slot blot; methoxyamine binding
notes: The obligate intermediate between glycosylase excision and gap filling. An AP site is MORE mutagenic than the base lesion it replaced; measuring it is how you detect a BER pathway that starts faster than it finishes. Methoxyamine binds AP sites covalently and has been used both as a blocking agent and as the basis of quantification

platform: duplex qPCR (mtDNA target vs nuclear reference)
notes: Interpreted only alongside the deletion burden below; copy number alone is ambiguous because it moves with both mitochondrial biogenesis and mitochondrial loss

platform: deletion-specific qPCR or droplet digital PCR
notes: Reported at higher levels in breast cancer patient blood with concurrently lower mtDNA content, alongside higher oxidative damage markers. Mitochondrial DNA lacks nucleotide excision repair and sits next to the electron transport chain, so it accumulates oxidative damage faster than nuclear DNA - a genuinely separate compartment the adduct panel does not see

platform: long-amplicon qPCR (amplification of long vs short target)
notes: Measures lesions functionally by their ability to block polymerase rather than chemically. Complements the adduct panel by reporting the mitochondrial compartment that nuclear DNA hydrolysate misses

platform: qPCR T/S ratio; terminal restriction fragment Southern; flow-FISH
notes: Telomeric DNA is guanine-rich and disproportionately sensitive to oxidative damage, and telomeres are refractory to repair. Psychological stress has been associated with higher oxidative stress, lower telomerase activity and shorter telomeres, with the highest-stress group shorter by the equivalent of at least a decade of additional ageing. Integrates months to years of exposure, where adducts integrate hours to days

platform: flow cytometry for loss of GPI-anchored proteins on erythrocytes
clinical_status: validated research assay with human biomonitoring data
notes: Reported background of roughly 2.9 to 5.56 per million mutant erythrocytes in healthy subjects, with increases after cigarette smoking, radiotherapy and occupational exposures including lead. Measures the endpoint the whole panel is about - a fixed mutation - rather than a lesion or a repair protein

measures: somatic mutation frequency and spectrum in normal tissue
platform: duplex consensus sequencing of targeted loci
notes: Reads both how many mutations accumulated and what kind, so it is simultaneously an outcome measure and a mechanism attribution. Being adopted as an alternative to transgenic rodent mutation assays; inter-individual variability in clonally expanded mutations is a known analytical challenge

marker: Cell-free DNA concentration and integrity index
platform: quantitative PCR or fragment analysis of short vs long amplicons
clinical_status: research use; clinically deployed in oncology for other purposes
role_in_panel: tissue damage and cell death load
notes: Rises with cell death and tissue injury. Included as context rather than as a DNA damage measure per se: it reports that cells died, not that their genomes were damaged. Requires strict pre-analytics because leukocyte lysis during handling contaminates the signal

measures: which mutational process produced the observed mutations
platform: whole-genome or whole-exome sequencing with signature deconvolution
matrix: tumour or clonally expanded normal tissue
notes: The only element that assigns observed mutations to a specific failed process - mismatch repair deficiency, homologous recombination deficiency, polymerase proofreading failure, oxidative damage and alkylating therapy each leave distinguishable single-base-substitution signatures. Requires adequate mutation count; exome-scale data give unstable fits
Included only where UV exposure is part of the question. Repaired exclusively by nucleotide excision repair, so they pair with the NER arm of the expression panel in the same way cyclopurines do
